visual_logic.surface_detail: Dark 'Whale-Grey' skin with a tactile, leathery quality. Minimal patterning to emphasize its gargantuan scale.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the 'toothless' suction-feeding snout and the massive, barrel-shaped torso; dwarfism of the flippers relative to the body size.
visual_logic.environment: Deep Triassic ocean waters with long, horizontal light rays slicing through the water column to frame its massive proportions.
visual_logic.pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive 21-meter long body is aligned perfectly flat in the upper half of the image, keeping the belly and throat clear so a second species can easily be drawn or stacked directly beneath it for side-by-side length comparison. The toothless mouth is slightly open in a gentle suction-feeding gulp, and its long tail extends straight back horizontally.
